units.title: SG-5.4 · Admin route tests prove every admin endpoint rejects missing and wrong tokens
Act: Register admin round routes from an adminRoute table
Act: Register admin execution routes from the same table
Verify: Admin round routes reject missing and wrong tokens unit tests

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundRoutesRejectMissingAndWrongToken
tests.title: Admin round routes reject requests with a missing or wrong token
tests.scenario: Given a server with admin.token tok and a temp repo_path, when each adminRoundRoutes entry is requested with no Authorization header and with 'Bearer wrong', then every response is 401
tests.detail: 5 routes x 2 cases, all 10 subtests returned 401

tests.name: TestAdminRoundRoutes_Table
tests.title: Admin round route table lists the five method and pattern pairs
tests.scenario: Given the adminRoundRoutes table, when it is read, then it contains exactly POST /rounds, POST /rounds/{id}/open, POST /rounds/{id}/close, GET /rounds/{id}, GET /rounds/{id}/contributions in that order
tests.detail: Table matches the five expected pairs

units.title: Verify: Admin execution routes reject missing and wrong tokens unit tests

tests.name: TestNew_AllAdminRoutesRejectMissingAndWrongToken
tests.title: Every admin route rejects missing and wrong tokens, and retry and approve accept the right token
tests.scenario: Given a server with admin.token tok, when each adminRoutes entry is requested without a token or with Bearer wrong, then 401; when POST retry and approve are requested with Bearer tok, then not 401
tests.detail: 8 routes x 2 cases all 401; 2 Bearer tok cases not 401

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoutesMatchTable
tests.title: The admin routes served by the router match the adminRoutes table exactly
tests.scenario: Given a server built by New, when chi.Walk lists routes under /api/v1/admin, then they equal the adminRoutes method and pattern pairs prefixed with /api/v1/admin
tests.detail: Walked set equals the table; no unlisted admin route

units.title: REQ · Admin round endpoints are registered from a route table and reject missing and wrong tokens
REQ · Admin execution endpoints incl. retry and approve are registered from the table and reject missing and wrong tokens
Evidence: Admin routes reject missing and wrong tokens unit tests
